title: Meeting
caveat: Findings from an automated review of an auto-captioned recording. Verify specifics against the video before repeating them.

findings.meeting_summary: The Mattoon City Council addressed public comments on municipal pet ordinances and neighborhood stormwater flooding before moving to regular agenda business. The council subsequently approved several measures including administrative positions, property acquisitions, urban forestry grants, water treatment plant upgrades, street striping, and drainage infrastructure projects.

topics.what_happened: The council considered a proposal to approve $74,868 for Hydro-Kinetics to replace modulating electric actuators on Filter #2 at the Water Treatment Plant. City staff explained that the new actuators replace 25-year-old equipment and match previously updated filters to allow standardized maintenance and repair parts.

topics.topic: Little Wabash Drainage Project & Water Quality
topics.what_happened: The council reviewed plans and specifications to authorize bidding for Phase 1 piping of the Little Wabash Drainage Project. A council member shared an email from a downstream resident raising concerns that increased drainage flow could exacerbate flooding and transport chemical runoff into the city's water supply.

citizen_concerns.concern: A downstream resident on Lake Road submitted an email expressing concern that faster drainage from the new 60-inch storm sewer pipe would increase downstream flooding and carry chemical runoff into Mattoon's municipal water supply.
citizen_concerns.response: City staff explained that planned future phases of the project incorporate detention basins near Circle Drive to slow water flow and mitigate downstream flooding.
